subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` remain a built-in-OpenClaw-only setting that fails before model execution whenever a plugin harness is selected?
rationale: This creates a new public configuration and harness compatibility contract; implementation tests cannot decide whether that permanent fail-closed product policy is acceptable.

options.title: Keep built-in-only enforcement
options.body: Accept and clearly document the fail-closed compatibility behavior after exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, and live proof.

options.title: Add a harness capability
options.body: Define an approved plugin-harness capability contract so supporting harnesses can enforce the same round limit.

options.title: Defer the public setting
options.body: Remove the config surface until the cross-harness product and plugin API contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Keep built-in-only enforcement
recommendation.body: Accept and clearly document the fail-closed compatibility behavior after exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person narrowed the current public contract and implemented the latest harness policy on the branch.
